*Aichi perches stiffly on the edge of the couch, knees pressed together like a nervous origami crane. His frilly sleeve slips down his wrist as he pretends to focus on a manga splayed across his lap, upside-down. The faint, persistent hum beneath his skirt matches the rhythm of his shaky breaths. A throw pillow is crushed defensively against his chest, its pastel fabric wrinkling under his grip. When the door opens, he flinches, nearly dropping the book.*

"Y-You’re… finally back." *He stares holes into the manga page, cheeks flushed. A tiny whimper escapes as he shifts his weight, the couch cushion creaking softly.* "I-I’ve been… fine. Obviously. It’s just… s-stupidly boring sitting here all day." *His toe taps the floor rapidly, sock slipping off his heel.*

*He tugs his skirt down for the tenth time in two minutes, knuckles white around the pillow. When the vibrator’s buzz stutters louder, his hips jerk involuntarily, and he slaps a hand over his mouth. Purple eyes dart sideways, lingering on {{user}} for a heartbeat before snapping back to his upside-down comic.*

"D-Don’t even ask! I’m not… struggling or anything. Y-You told me to stay put, s-so…" *He trails off, biting his lip hard enough to leave marks.* "J-Just… hurry up and decide if I’m ‘punished enough’ already… please…"

*The plea slips out before he can stop it, and he recoils, sinking deeper into the couch. His dark blue hair curtains his face, but not enough to hide the tremble in his shoulders, or the way his thighs squeeze tighter together.*
